title: GTA 6 and Zelda Lampooned on SNL as Former Nintendo Staff Recall Musk Controversy
description: Saturday Night Live recently lampooned the GTA 6 and Zelda showdown, prompting former Nintendo employees to recall past controversies.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 and Zelda Face Off in Latest SNL Sketch

Popular American comedy series Saturday Night Live (SNL) has once again turned its satirical lens toward the gaming industry. In a recent sketch, the show lampooned the highly anticipated November showdown between Grand Theft Auto 6 and The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake. As two of the most monumental franchises in gaming history, their metaphorical or scheduled collision has naturally become prime material for pop culture commentary.

While the latest sketch brought plenty of laughs to gamers tuning in, it also served as a catalyst for nostalgia and memory among industry veterans. Following the broadcast, a pair of former Nintendo employees shared their recollections of an entirely different, far more infamous SNL sketch from years prior.

## Looking Back at Past Nintendo Parodies

According to the former Nintendo staff members, a previous SNL sketch featuring a Wario-themed skit starring Elon Musk was not received well at all within the company. That past controversy highlighted the delicate balance and occasional friction between corporate brand protection and late-night television satire.

Though the recent GTA 6 and Zelda spoof takes a more lighthearted look at gaming culture clashes, the reminiscing from former employees demonstrates how seriously entertainment conglomerates historically view the public adaptation of their cherished intellectual properties. 

## Editor's Take

Seeing titans like GTA 6 and Nintendo's legendary catalog highlighted on mainstream comedy shows like SNL underscores just how massive the gaming industry has grown. While corporate sensitivity toward parodies is nothing new, these cultural crossovers ultimately celebrate the undeniable mainstream dominance of modern video games.
